scope: Full libghostty-vt compatibility; native app/font/GPU validation is separate.
rules: Thorough may pass only when every requirement is complete, exported by both adapters and exercised by passing cases.
A smoke pass is not a full-parity claim. Snapshot comparison alone is insufficient.

requirements.remaining: Control-sequence cases and upstream fuzz corpus have not all been ported.

Row prompt metadata and OSC 133 redraw policies are compared across resize and snapshots. Native non-reflow truncation now clears both halves of a wide cell, repairing a later insertion crash; 144 comparisons cover both screens, active/inactive state, graphemes, links, styles and snapshot continuation. Initial and resized pixel geometry is compared in snapshots for terminal and input requests, including missing/zero cell sizes, saturated products, unchanged grids and mode-2048 reports. The adapters now initialize identical pixel geometry for input requests. The internal viewport anchor survives returning to the active area; saved cursors and external pins agree across 1200 comparisons through narrowing, widening, line edits, history clearing and viewport movement. Empty wrap continuations are dropped without adding hard breaks; 648 comparisons cover retained cursor/selection pins, semantic rows and backgrounds. Reflow preserves the blank tail copied from a wrapped source row instead of trimming it as deferred empty space; generated/2/979 has a retained ASCII regression. Complete reflow, height changes, scrollback pruning and tracked-reference cases remain.

Mode/cursor defaults, saved bits, color persistence, RIS, and direct-reset continuation through UTF-8/ESC/CSI/OSC/DCS/APC including capture limits are compared; graphics and other reset state still need complete coverage.
Mode saved/default state, colors and cursor/mouse transition effects are optionally observed; saved cursor, viewport and complete continuation remain.

Cell comparison exists; ECH/EL/DCH wrap resets, next-row continuation and wide spacer cleanup have focused snapshot coverage. Non-reflow growth and restored-page edits retain spacer-head attributes and native copied-versus-reused row wrap flags across 96 comparisons. Complete grapheme, protection, wide-cell and semantic cases remain.

Live STYLE admission, cursor/cell references, dead-ID reuse, rehash/growth, restored sparse IDs, resize and mixed-width IND copies have bounded coverage. The native max-capacity split cursor-cache defect is repaired and its six retained comparisons pass. Native and Rust narrow-page mutation now agree across 96 first-IND and continued-printing comparisons. Complete SGR/state transitions and resource-exhaustion combinations remain.
Both screens/history are observed; complete screen-switch behavior remains.
Cursor shape, visibility/blink and configured reset defaults are compared; saved cursor and all motion cases remain.
Host query decisions, mode reports and xterm/Kitty color replies are compared; disabled PTY writes and complete control contexts remain.

Raw bytes, UTF-8 validation before truncation, fixed capture/prefix behavior, direct setters and snapshot restoration are compared; disabled callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Opaque raw bytes, OSC7/ConEmu/iTerm2 aliases, fixed capture/prefix behavior, uncapped setters and snapshots are compared; disabled callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
BEL callback is observed; parser contexts and notification interaction remain.
All 1,112,064 valid Unicode scalar widths are compared; invalid scalar boundaries are rejected. Grapheme composition is tracked under terminal.cells.

Raw parser/UTF-8 events and inherited parser corpora are compared; exhaustive transition/boundary combinations and capture-limit behavior remain. Raw OSC observation does not validate command semantics.

Validated title/PWD, color, notification and clipboard semantics plus fixed capture/prefix cases are compared. Native OSC 66/99 deliberately unimplemented terminal callbacks are verified as no-ops across payload/capture boundaries, malformed input and continuation. Direct OSC parser corpus and 176 focused fixtures pass 648 comparisons of terminal state and host effects, preserving all selector/payload bytes, missing terminators, embedded controls, capture boundaries and pending CSI continuation. Typed metadata for ignored commands, remaining OSC commands, streaming capture allocation and complete malformed contexts remain.

All current source modes, raw saved/default bits, guarded reset policy, DECRQM and basic stream/mouse/cursor transitions are compared; complete cross-mode interactions and screen/input behavior remain.

Current/default/override state, all palette indices, native X11 names, RGB/intensity parsing and xterm/Kitty reply matrices are compared; intermediate capture/continuation, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.

Direct bounds/text, rectangles, wide/grapheme cells and whitespace/wrap cases pass. Pure word, word-between, line, all and output queries pass 384 comparisons across 128 fixtures. All ten selection-end adjustments pass 450 comparisons across 150 fixtures, including reversed/rectangular endpoints, blank and written-space rows, wide spacers, history, alternate screens and mixed physical widths. Plain/VT/HTML selection export with all trim/unwrap combinations passes 363 comparisons across 121 fixtures. Full screen/terminal exports and optional state replay pass 279 comparisons across 93 fixtures, including native PWD terminator repair, pending wrap, mode defaults and restored pages. Explicit foreground/background/palette options and character/string replacements are compared across formats, all entry points, Unicode, page boundaries and cursor replay. Gesture press/drag/release, repeats, deep press and autoscroll pass 1221 comparisons across 407 cell/word/line/output fixtures, including reset/pruned anchors. Raw per-byte page coordinates are compared for all formatter cases, including UTF-8, escaped/replaced text, styles, links, state extras and page-boundary blanks. Complete mutation lifetimes remain.

Literal bytes, ASCII folding, formatter coordinates, page order/overlap/trimming and no-scrollback prefix pruning are compared without normalization. Persistent viewport feeds and cached reads are covered. Full-history feed/tick, indexed results, selected-match retention/fallback and wrapping, screen switches, pruning, resize, reset, snapshot prepend and restored-width edits pass 612 comparisons across 204 fixtures, including viewport-pin reflow and cached history after same-width movement. Owned search pins expire on drop; ticks read no terminal state. The repaired native short-window case remains in all 237 page-search comparisons. Complete resource-driven mutation lifetimes and regex extension coverage remain.

Page/resource capacity and offset arithmetic, column adjustment and pooled/exact allocation charge are compared on macOS ARM64 without backing allocations. Live STYLE, grapheme and hyperlink/string retention, fragmentation and growth have bounded coverage under terminal.pages; full splitting, resource inheritance and other platform ABIs remain.

Initialization, growth, whole-page pruning, clear/reset, dimension changes, reflow and snapshot admission compare native boundaries, capacities and allocation charges on macOS ARM64. Live STYLE ownership, growth and mixed-width row copies have bounded coverage. Native STYLE splits and narrow-page mutations are repaired; Rust follows corrected growth, padding and cursor metadata across 96 mixed-width comparisons. Live grapheme chunk ownership, fragmentation, projected growth, erasure, row moves/copies, reflow, mixed restored widths, tiny capacities and snapshot continuation pass 777 comparisons across 259 fixtures. Growth rebuilds both resource ledgers atomically, and viewport copies own no allocations. Live hyperlink/string ownership, delayed reclamation, deduplication, hash collisions, cursor page crossings, temporary SU/SD cursor moves, growth, erasure, reflow, mixed restored widths and snapshot continuation pass 297 comparisons across 99 fixtures. Snapshot encoding preserves native LINK IDs and cursor-only references, including tables above 511 entries. Splitting during reflow, compression and complete lifecycle/resource-exhaustion combinations remain.

Live coordinates/codepoints are compared through reflow, erasure, resets, handle reuse and screen switches. Owner isolation, reset lifetime, inactive release, line shifts and alternate/history pin motion pass. IL/DL/SU/SD with full and partial margins, zero/oversized counts, primary/alternate screens, disabled scrollback and ED22-retained history pass 768 comparisons across 256 fixtures. Scroll path selection uses the active screen's actual byte limit, preserving pins and wrap flags with scrollback disabled. Rebinding, exact pruning and snapshot restoration remain.

Stored IDs, dimensions and RGBA pixels for raw/PNG/zlib uploads on both screens are compared. Tagged placement keys, requested/source/pixel/grid geometry, zero pixel sizes, ordinary cursor/display/deletion/retransmission, basic history/reflow/screen/reset lifecycle and simple parent-orphan/virtual-clear cases are compared. Ordinary relative-parent choice, validation/error precedence, eight-link chains and per-link saturated offsets pass 192 comparisons across 64 fixtures. Unicode placeholder runs, all reference diacritics, ID inheritance, explicit/fallback targets, basic viewport lifecycle and rounded pixel geometry pass 1,452 comparisons across 484 fixtures. The renderer shares the VT geometry; regressions cover virtual-root minimum origins and clamped sampling for tiny/overhanging rounded source rectangles. Deterministic animation ticks compare next wakeup delays, mutation signals, all frame pixels/gaps, current display, loop counters and timestamps across 90 fixtures. Unplaced images schedule no redraws; loading and finite loops retain the last displayed frame, clock restarts re-anchor deadlines, and repeated controls preserve active timing and pixel generations. Another 13 selected lifecycle scenarios (39 comparisons) cover root/current/neighbor deletion, surviving pixels/deadlines, frame editing/composition and replies, PNG/zlib/raw frames, short/excess data, partial uploads during playback or deletion, retransmission, screen switches and reset. Native deletion-index and upload-identity bugs were repaired; Rust deletion, composition and raw-frame decoding now match these cases. One renderer regression verifies uploaded pixels and texture reuse through edits, composition, animation, deletion and retransmission. Placeholder zero-cell/overflow cases, complete margin clipping, pruning, virtual-root viewport edges, transports, exhaustive animation editing/deletion, snapshots and resource limits remain.

Real bounded Wuffs decoding and stored pixels are compared across color types/depths, transparency, Adam7, truncation, checksums and dimension precedence; APNG, ancillary chunks and complete resource/error limits remain.

Headless glyf uploads, exact outlines/design/constraints, ordered replacement/eviction, replies, dirty state, configured capture and decoder limits, and snapshot continuation/omission are compared; font coverage, visible rasterization and allocator-failure injection remain.

OSC 52/5522 metadata, binary reads/writes, MIME filtering, streamed base64, aliases, statuses, callback absence, configured limits, session grants, one-time paste grants and exact 8 MiB OSC capture boundaries are compared. OSC 1337 Copy shares OSC 52 decoding and host policy; case-insensitive keys, binary data, malformed/query/empty values, fixed capture boundaries, disabled callbacks, reply statuses, event order and direct-reset continuation pass 645 comparisons across 215 fixtures. Allocation failures and complete size limits remain.

OSC 72 metadata, registration/status chunks, callback-time state, host move/drop/leave, binary data replies, local-only errors, MIME/item limits, exact 8 MiB capture boundaries, direct-reset capture continuation and snapshot omission are compared. Allocation failures and direct utility APIs remain.
All named keys in the native legacy/Kitty tables, text fallback, IME, modifier-side bits and macOS Option policies are compared; host event mapping and complete text/control combinations remain.

All modes/formats, buttons, independent held-button state, renderer padding, zero/tiny/maximum surfaces, retained cell deduplication, explicit tracking reset and continuation through terminal reset/resize/screen/mode changes pass 1266 comparisons across 422 fixtures. Renderer geometry is independent of terminal dimensions, and UTF-8 coordinates may occupy three or four bytes. Rustty panes own their tracking state and retain fractional renderer bounds. Native surrogate-coordinate and grid/pixel overflow crashes are repaired: numeric conversion saturates and unencodable UTF-8 reports emit no partial bytes. Maximum padding and native f32 viewport rounding are compared. Complete malformed host geometry and allocation/writer-failure behavior remain.

Focus, binary paste encodings, safety checks, mode precedence, Kitty paste events, one-time grants, lazy readers and entropy/read errors are compared; disabled output callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Current source terminfo capabilities, host-specified names and DECRQSS styles/margins/cursor replies pass; all control contexts and resource limits remain.

OSC9/777 notification bytes, ConEmu classification/progress/fresh prompts, fixed captures and explicit host query decisions are compared. Native OSC 99 has no notification callback or replies, including multipart/query/close messages; that unsupported behavior is verified. Disabled callback combinations remain.

Both encodings and uninterrupted continuation are compared; PAGE STYLE/LINK admission, hyperlink string lifetimes/deduplication and linked-cell limits have bounded coverage. The native short-bitmap allocation failure is repaired; all 660 hyperlink resource comparisons pass. Both decoders now reserve whole grapheme suffixes, repairing native packed-page roundtrip loss caused by transient append allocations. All 534 grapheme resource comparisons pass, including malformed/duplicate entries, full arenas, retry after failed admission and three packed reflow cross-decode fixtures. Complete metadata, lazy mixed-width PAGEs and all state transitions remain.

READY/history/FINISH state and source offsets are compared with live mutations and transport tails. Width changes away/back, permanent discard after a skipped PAGE, reset, alternate-screen recreation, height changes and limits pass 78 comparisons. Complete mutation-policy combinations, continuation replay and I/O failures remain.

Complete-v1, every truncation, selected corruptions, exact-decode tails, terminal/screen metadata fallbacks and malformed record structure are compared. Shared continuation decode budgets and later live capture are checked through full/exact/ready APIs; Rust regressions retain normal capture under tiny and raised import budgets, and reader/writer failures at record boundaries. Native cursor bounds are repaired and 45 mixed-width cursor comparisons pass. Allocation-failure injection, remaining component fields and complete mixed PAGE transitions need coverage.

All 3,295 inherited terminal-stream byte fixtures pass 9,885 delivery comparisons; --corpus can replay them independently with case filtering. Parser corpora are covered under parser.raw-events. All 1000 mixed-operation cases from seed 2 pass 3000 delivery comparisons after retaining three cursor/blank-row resize regressions, and all 40 inherited direct OSC records now pass 120 comparisons using their exact terminator selectors and raw payloads. Direct OSC comparison observes terminal state and effects; ignored command metadata, allocator/resource limits, broader mixed operations and invariants remain.
